collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected

accounts_expected.description: Number of accounts the collection was configured to cover

all_accounts_collected.description: Whether every account the collection was configured to cover answered

users_present.description: Whether the account has any human user identities that can sign in to it. When false, mfa_coverage_pct has no users to count

user_count.description: Number of human user identities that can sign in to the account. mfa_coverage_pct counts these users

mfa_user_count.description: Users counted in user_count who have MFA enabled

mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of human user identities that can sign in to the account and have MFA enabled

root_mfa_enabled.description: Whether the account's highest-privilege owner identity (the AWS root user, a Google Cloud organization administrator, an Azure Global Administrator) has MFA enabled

root_access_protected.description: Whether the account's highest-privilege owner identity (the AWS root user, a Google Cloud organization administrator, an Azure Global Administrator) is protected from password-only use, by MFA or by having no standing credentials

access_keys_present.description: Whether any user has an active long-lived programmatic credential (access keys, service account keys, client secrets). When false, access_key_rotation_compliant_pct has no users to count

access_key_user_count.description: Number of users with an active long-lived programmatic credential (access keys, service account keys, client secrets). access_key_rotation_compliant_pct counts these users

rotation_compliant_user_count.description: Users counted in access_key_user_count whose active credentials are all rotated within policy

access_key_rotation_compliant_pct.description: Percentage of users with an active long-lived programmatic credential (access keys, service account keys, client secrets) whose active credentials are all rotated within policy (typically 90 days)

saml_providers_present.description: Whether the account trusts any SAML identity provider directly for sign-in. A provider created by a workforce sign-in service such as AWS IAM Identity Center is not counted

saml_provider_count.description: Number of SAML identity providers the account trusts directly for sign-in. A provider created by a workforce sign-in service such as AWS IAM Identity Center is not counted

storage_resources_present.description: Whether the account has any storage resources. When false, the storage percentages are null

storage_resource_count.description: Storage resources the storage percentages count, such as S3 buckets or Azure storage accounts

encrypted_storage_resource_count.description: Storage resources with encryption at rest

public_access_blocked_storage_resource_c.description: Storage resources with public access blocked

encryption_pct.description: Percentage of storage resources with encryption at rest

public_access_blocked_pct.description: Percentage of storage resources with public access blocked

databases_present.description: Whether the account has any managed databases, such as RDS instances, Aurora clusters, or Azure SQL databases. When false, the database percentages are null

database_count.description: Managed databases in the account. The database percentages count these

encrypted_database_count.description: Databases encrypted at rest, judged by the storage encryption type where the provider reports one

encryption_pct.description: Percentage of databases encrypted at rest. Null when the account has no databases

public_access_blocked_database_count.description: Databases that cannot be reached from the public internet

public_access_blocked_pct.description: Percentage of databases that cannot be reached from the public internet. Null when the account has no databases

multi_az_database_count.description: Databases that run across availability zones. For Aurora, this is read from the cluster

multi_az_pct.description: Percentage of databases that run across availability zones. It is evidence about configuration only and does not show that recovery works. Null when the account has no databases

audit_log_enabled.description: Whether an account-wide audit log of management activity is enabled, for example CloudTrail, Cloud Audit Logs, or an exported Azure Activity Log

audit_log_all_regions.description: Whether the audit log covers every region the account uses. True where the provider's audit log is global

cloudtrail_enabled.description: Deprecated alias of audit_log_enabled, with the same value. Removed in v2

cloudtrail_multiregion.description: Deprecated alias of audit_log_all_regions, with the same value. Removed in v2

security_groups_present.description: Whether the account has any security groups or network security groups, or firewall rules on Google Cloud. When false, the network percentages are null

security_group_count.description: Security groups or network security groups, or firewall rules on Google Cloud. The network percentages count these

ssh_open_security_group_count.description: Security groups with a rule that allows SSH (port 22) from any address

rdp_open_security_group_count.description: Security groups with a rule that allows RDP (port 3389) from any address

ssh_open_to_world_pct.description: Percentage of security groups or network security groups (firewall rules on Google Cloud) with a rule that allows SSH (port 22) from any address

rdp_open_to_world_pct.description: Percentage of security groups or network security groups (firewall rules on Google Cloud) with a rule that allows RDP (port 3389) from any address

retention_days_min.description: Minimum backup retention period across all backup-enabled resources (days). Null when no resource has backups enabled. Left out with a gap when a read failed

enabled.description: Whether vulnerability scanning is enabled (Inspector/Security Command Center/Defender)

scanned_resources_present.description: Whether the scanner covered any resources. When false, unpatched_pct is null

scanned_resource_count.description: Resources the vulnerability scanner covered. unpatched_pct counts these

unpatched_pct.description: Percentage of scanned resources with unpatched vulnerabilities

enabled.description: True when threat detection, such as Amazon GuardDuty, is on in every enabled region

workforce_sign_in.description: A central sign-in service that signs people in to the accounts, such as AWS IAM Identity Center. Left out when the collector does not report one

in_use.description: Whether people can sign in to any of the accounts through the workforce sign-in service

user_count.description: Number of users in the workforce sign-in service's directory

mfa_source.description: Where the workforce sign-in service's users have MFA set. It is sign_in_service when the service itself sets it, external_idp when an external identity provider that the users come from sets it, and unknown when the collector cannot tell
